newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prison rebellion ends with six dead.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prison rebellion ends with six dead.

text.p: Six people were killed and four injured in a prison rebellion in the northeastern Brazilian city of Recife, which was put down by police early on Monday, a police spokesman said.
He said police stormed the prison where three inmates were holding 25 people hostage after an unsuccessful break-out attempt during visiting hour on Sunday.
The three prisoners and one visitor to the jail were killed and four people were injured during the police operation, the spokesman said. Two police officers had been shot previously by the inmates.
The injured were taken to a hospital in Recife.
Police decided to storm the prison after negotiations with the prisoners broke down.
